overviewParagraphs: Aquella Golf Resort & Country Club represents Phuket's most modern premium golf offering — a meticulously crafted coastal facility featuring platinum paspalum turf throughout the course, a playing surface prized in tropical golf for its salt tolerance, visual vibrancy, and superior playability in humid conditions. The result is fairways and greens that look and play immaculately regardless of Phuket's seasonal weather.

The course design takes full advantage of its coastal positioning — multiple holes play off elevated tees with Andaman Sea panoramas, and the routing thread between the island's hillside and coastal terrain creates a pleasing variety of hole shapes and challenge levels. It is a course that rewards both experienced tournament golfers and resort visitors approaching the game more casually.

AGS recommends Aquella for clients who want a premium but comfortable Phuket round alongside the dramatic experiences of Red Mountain and Blue Canyon. Its modern facilities and excellent service standards make it a natural fit for any high-end Phuket golf program.

curatorBriefHtml: Aquella Golf & Country Club (opened 2021 by Pacific Coast Design on the pristine Thai Muang coastline just north of Phuket Island) is Southern Thailand’s standout modern resort layout. Measuring 6,532 yards from the Blue Tees (Par 72), the wall-to-wall Platinum Paspalum course blends sleek modern bunkering, vintage railway-sleeper retaining walls, and a signature beachfront par-3 11th hole playing right beside the Andaman Sea.

Having played Aquella personally, the contrast against Phuket’s older, hillier tracks is immediate: fairways are wide, crisp, and spotless, pace of play is unhurried, and the contemporary clubhouse plus coastal breeze make it a joy for both single-figure players and holidaying four-balls.

Sitting just 35 minutes north of Phuket International Airport (HKT) — across the Sarasin Bridge in Phang Nga — Aquella pairs effortlessly with Blue Canyon, Laguna Golf Phuket, and Red Mountain from luxury Bang Tao or Mai Khao bases.

scorecard.verdict: Phang Nga's premier coastal links facility. Located on the pristine sands of Thai Muang Beach, Aquella features firm, bouncy turf, authentic sea breezes, and an exquisite beachfront signature par-3.

faqs.q: Where is Aquella Golf & Country Club located relative to Phuket?
faqs.a: Aquella lies just across the Sarasin Bridge in Thai Muang (Phang Nga Province) — roughly 35–40 minutes north of Phuket International Airport (HKT) and 45–50 minutes from Bang Tao / Laguna Phuket.

faqs.q: What is the signature hole at Aquella Golf & Country Club?
faqs.a: The par-3 11th hole plays right along the white-sand shoreline of the Andaman Sea, framed by sea breezes and Aquella’s trademark dark railway-sleeper bunkers.

faqs.q: How does Aquella compare to Red Mountain and Blue Canyon?
faqs.a: Aquella is flatter, newer, wider off the tee, and immaculate from tee to green — making it the ideal relaxing, high-polish resort round alongside dramatic canyon golf at Red Mountain and championship history at Blue Canyon.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play golf around Phuket and Phang Nga?
faqs.a: November through April is Phuket’s dry Andaman high season with calm blue skies and low rainfall. May through October brings greener, quieter fairways with morning tee times usually staying dry.
